note: PROTOTYPE - NOT VERIFIED. Colorado wage withholding per DR 1098 annualized method: (period wages x periods) - annual withholding allowance, x flat rate, / periods. The 4.4% rate and the allowance amounts below are entered from memory and must be checked against the current DR 1098 before real use. If the employee filed a DR 0004, its annual allowance (people.co_allowance) replaces the W-4-status default.

source.title: Colorado DR 1098 - Colorado Withholding Worksheet for Employers

famli.note: Employers with fewer than 10 employees pay no employer share (the employee share is still withheld). Premium wage cap = SS wage base.

suta.note: Employer rate comes from the org setting (demo 3.05%).
